Landlord Admin Console

All admin circuits require the landlord's private signing key as a ZK witness for authorization. The key is never transmitted — only the derived commitment is verified on-chain.

Landlord Circuits
setLandlordCommitment(Uint<32>)
Anchor landlord authority + set income threshold
revokeAgreement(Bytes<32>)
Revoke a fraudulent lease (ZK auth)
resetProperty(Bytes<32>, Uint<32>)
Reset property ID + income threshold
incrementSession()
Bump session nonce (replay protection)
🔑 Panel 1 — setLandlordCommitment(Uint<32>)

Anchors the landlord's public commitment on-chain and sets the minimum monthly income requirement for prospective tenants.

🚫 Panel 2 — revokeAgreement(Bytes<32>)

Revoke or terminate a specific lease commitment. Requires landlord authority proof via landlordSigningKey() ZK witness. Stored in lastRevokedCommitment.

🔄 Panel 3 — resetProperty(Bytes<32>, Uint<32>)

Reset the active rental property ID and update the minimum monthly income requirement. Bumps session for clean epoch boundary.

🔒 Panel 4 — incrementSession()

Bumps the activeSession nonce to invalidate stale proofs from previous epochs.
